requirement: A Particular keeps a private list of their gear
expected: Mi cuenta › Mi equipo lists items with brand, model, type, serial, purchase date, warranty end and note; another account and stores see nothing
steps: Add an item; open the list as another account; `tests/feat-selling-tools.sql`

requirement: A verified purchase lands in the buyer's Mi equipo once
expected: Confirming a purchase adds one item with the listing's details; confirming again adds nothing
preconditions: A verified transaction for a Particular buyer
steps: Confirm a purchase; open Mi equipo; `tests/feat-selling-tools.sql`

requirement: Mi equipo shows no estimated value
expected: No value, price estimate or valuation appears on the list or an item
steps: Open Mi equipo and an item

requirement: Vender esto opens the sell form with the item's details
expected: A draft is created with category, type, brand, model and the profile's city; a second tap continues the same draft

requirement: Store owners use Inventario, not Mi equipo
expected: A store owner who opens /mi-cuenta/equipo is sent to Ofertas, and the database refuses their gear writes

requirement: Warranty status is shown
expected: A warranty ending within 30 days is marked; an ended one says so
preconditions: An item with a warranty date
steps: Set warranty dates in the past, within 30 days and later

requirement: Removing an item asks once and removes it
expected: After confirming, the item and its reminder are gone

requirement: A store opts in to buying used gear
expected: Qué recibimos saves Compramos usados with its categories for a verified store; an unverified store cannot turn it on; everything starts off

requirement: The person sees how many stores will receive the request before writing
expected: The form shows the real count of verified stores of their region that buy the category, or that there are none
preconditions: Stores with Compramos usados in Lima
steps: Open Pedir ofertas a tiendas and change the category

requirement: A request reaches only qualifying stores
expected: Active, verified stores of the same region that buy the category get it in Ofertas, a notification and an e-mail; others never see it
preconditions: Stores in two regions, one unverified
steps: Send a request; open Ofertas as each store; `tests/feat-selling-tools.sql`

requirement: Request photos stay private
expected: Photos load only for the requester and the stores that may see the request; anyone else gets 404; uploads outside the person's own folder are refused
steps: Open a photo URL signed out, as another person and as a store of another region

requirement: Each store sends one offer within 24 hours
expected: A store can send, change or withdraw one offer while the window is open; after it the form is closed
steps: Send and change an offer; try after the window

requirement: The person chooses one offer, or none
expected: Choosing shares their name and WhatsApp with that store only, shows its address and a drop-off date in 5 days, and closes the other offers with a notice to those stores

requirement: The store's contact details stay hidden until chosen
expected: The store sees no name or phone before it is chosen
steps: Open the request as a store

requirement: The store records the outcome
expected: After the visit the store records the final price or what happened; the person is told

requirement: Requests expire on their own
expected: An open request nobody chose expires after its decision window and both sides are told; an accepted one is closed 30 days after drop-off

requirement: Abuse limits
expected: At most 5 open requests per person and 10 a day; phone numbers and links in the text are refused

requirement: The sell page offers ¿Prefieres vender ya? only when it is real
expected: The card appears on a new sell form only when stores of the region buy at least one category, naming them
steps: Open Publicar with and without buying stores

requirement: A verified store invites the owner of a consigned instrument
expected: The store creates a link from the listing's selling tools (shown once, valid 7 days); a new link replaces the old one
preconditions: A verified store with consignment on, a listing not controlled by Inventario

requirement: The owner accepts and follows the listing
expected: After accepting, the listing reads En consignación en <Tienda> and the owner sees views, WhatsApp contacts and saves in Mi equipo
steps: Open the link as a Particular and accept

requirement: A sale or an archive closes the consignment
expected: Marking the listing sold tells the owner by notification and e-mail; archiving ends it; either side can end it

requirement: A store accepts gear as part payment
expected: The store default and the per-listing choice decide whether the listing shows Aceptamos tu equipo como parte de pago; the owner never sees it on their own listing
steps: Change the default and the listing choice; open the listing as a buyer and as the owner

requirement: A buyer offers their gear for one listing
expected: The request goes to that listing's store only; the store answers with an estimate within 72 hours and the buyer has 7 more days to accept
steps: Ofrecer mi equipo from the listing; answer as the store

requirement: A copied listing keeps its part-payment choice
expected: Duplicating or relisting a store listing copies accepts_part_payment through the listing-details registry
preconditions: A store listing with part payment set

requirement: An owner sets a floor and a pace
expected: A floor below the price (at least 20 % of it), 5 % or 10 %, every 7 or 14 days; the page shows the resulting steps before saving
preconditions: An approved listing not controlled by Inventario

requirement: The job lowers due prices and never below the floor
expected: Each due step lowers the price in whole soles, notifies the owner and triggers the usual price-drop alert; it finishes at the floor

requirement: A step waits after a WhatsApp contact
expected: With Solo si nadie me escribió on, a contact since the last step skips it and tells the owner
preconditions: A due rule and a contact
steps: Record a contact; run the job

requirement: Steps stop at a sale and skip paused or out-of-stock listings
expected: A sold or hidden listing finishes the rule; a paused one is skipped
preconditions: Rules on listings in each state

requirement: Buyers see no urgency
expected: The listing page shows no countdown, schedule or future price

requirement: The owner sends a private price to people who saved the listing
expected: Below the public price (at least 20 % of it), 1 to 7 days, once per listing per 7 days; the public price does not change
steps: Herramientas de venta › Oferta a interesados

requirement: The saver sees the offer and asks for it by WhatsApp
expected: The listing shows Oferta para ti with its end date and Pedir este precio por WhatsApp, which opens the listing's WhatsApp with a message quoting the offer; others see nothing
steps: Open the listing as the saver and as someone else

requirement: The offer e-mail respects the price-drop choice
expected: A person who turned price-drop e-mails off gets only the notification; the e-mail carries No más bajas de precio
preconditions: Two savers, one with price-drop e-mails off

requirement: A reminder to change strings, reeds or drumheads is opt-in
expected: An item whose type uses them offers one reminder, off until turned on, every 1 to 12 months

requirement: The reminder arrives once and names nearby stores
expected: When due, one notification and one e-mail name up to three active stores of the region that sell them, city first; the job sends it once per due date
preconditions: A due reminder; a store that sells strings

requirement: Stopping is one tap
expected: Ya las cambié hoy moves the date; Dejar de recordar stops it; the e-mail's No más recordatorios stops every reminder without signing in

requirement: The selling jobs are protected and repeatable
expected: Each /api/internal/jobs route refuses a missing or wrong CRON_SECRET and running a job twice in a day changes nothing the second time
steps: Call each route without and with the secret, twice

requirement: Unused request photos are removed
expected: Photos of requests never sent go after 2 days and photos of requests closed 90 days ago go too

requirement: Account menus
expected: A Particular sees Mi equipo; a store owner with a store sees Ofertas; Mis publicaciones rows link Herramientas de venta and show the tools in use

requirement: Laria never takes part in the money
expected: Every screen and e-mail of these tools says the store or the seller pays directly; Laria charges nothing and shows no valuation

requirement: Mobile layout and accessibility
expected: At 390 px nothing scrolls sideways, targets are at least 24 px, and status never relies on color alone
steps: Screens at 390 and 1366 px; a11y scripts
